title: Vision Transformers for Estimating Irradiance Using Data Scarce Sky Images
abstract: arXiv:2610.30940v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate estimation of diffuse horizontal irradiance (DHI) is critical for optimising photovoltaic system performance and energy forecasting yet remains challenging in regions lacking comprehensive ground-based instrumentation. Recent advancements using Vision Transformers (ViTs) trained on extensive sky image datasets have shown promise in replacing costly irradiance measurement equipment, but the scarcity of long-term, high-quality sky imagery significantly restricts practical implementation. Addressing this critical gap, this study proposes a novel dual-framework approach designed for data-scarce scenarios. First, calculated atmospheric parameters, including extraterrestrial irradiance and cyclic time encodings, are integrated to represent sky conditions without utilising any instrumentation. Next, a sequential pipeline initially predicts synthetic global horizontal irradiance (GHI) and uses it as a feature, to refine DHI estimation

translated_title: 基于数据稀缺天空图像的视觉Transformer辐照度估计方法
translated_abstract: 准确估计散射水平辐照度（DHI）对于优化光伏系统性能和能量预测至关重要，但在缺乏全面地面观测仪器的地区仍然是一项挑战。近期的研究进展表明，利用在大量天空图像数据集上训练的视觉Transformer（ViT）有望替代昂贵的辐照度测量设备，然而长期高质量天空图像数据的稀缺严重限制了其实际应用。针对这一关键缺口，本研究提出了一种专为数据稀缺场景设计的新型双框架方法。首先，整合计算得到的气象参数（包括地外辐照度和周期性时间编码）来表征天空状况，无需使用任何仪器设备。其次，采用顺序流水线，先预测合成的全球水平辐照度（GHI），并将其作为特征，用于改进DHI的估计。
tldr: 该论文提出一种面向数据稀缺场景的双框架视觉Transformer方法，通过整合计算大气参数（地外辐照度与周期性时间编码）并以顺序预测的合成GHI作为特征，无需昂贵测量仪器即可从天空图像准确估计散射水平辐照度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel dual-framework Vision Transformer approach for data-scarce scenarios that integrates calculated atmospheric parameters (extraterrestrial irradiance and cyclic time encodings) with a sequential pipeline using predicted synthetic GHI as a feature, enabling accurate DHI estimation from sky images without requiring costly instrumentation.
